model.inventory_semantics: Perishable stock; lost sales; exogenous Markov regime and previous contract are the persistent state. Premium and incremental shortage compensation are external contractual transfers, not internal relabeling of physical cost.

optimization.method: Exhaustive exact rational backward induction; no training or configuration search.
optimization.tie_break: Greatest product-order maximizer, checked directly; lexicographic (value, stock, contract) is used only after lattice closure is verified.
optimization.accounting: Report 13 stock choices and 11 contract choices per state. Frozen and dummy-gate comparators have unrestricted state-aware stock tables; distinguish distinct economic actions from repeated slots.
optimization.primary: Exact expected discounted net contractual reward relative to the frozen contract 1/2.

simulation.no_selection: Use every seed and every specified comparator. Do not tune numerical primitives after seeing outcomes.
simulation.uncertainty: Paired batch means and standard errors quantify simulation error only. Exact model expectations are primary; no field-validation or training-variability inference.

conditioning.model: dU=sqrt(2*epsilon)dW, T=1, payoff U_T^2/2; exact P(0,u)=u.
conditioning.method: Fit k*u^2/2+b and the identical value critic reparameterized by zeta=sqrt(2*epsilon)*k to the same stochastic-return data. No independent additive Z-target noise is injected.
conditioning.metric: Integrated gradient MSE=(k-1)^2/3, design condition numbers, induced Z error, and transformed-coefficient parity.

additional_analyses.canonical_network: Construct exact max-affine-minus-quadratic value network and rational hysteresis breakpoints; certify Bellman residuals on all previous-contract values in [0,1] for the specified finite action grid.
additional_analyses.scheme: Prove a scheme-specific continuous-action quantization bound using an explicit Lipschitz constant, separately from finite-model exactness and diffusion HJB comparison.
additional_analyses.pde: Boundary-complete stopped diffusion verification and explicit monotone upwind/central-diffusion scheme. A manufactured quadratic certificate is a separate diffusion instance, never relabeled as inventory evidence.
additional_analyses.historical: Retain every historical file and negative result; repair metric definitions through a traceable ledger rather than overwriting historical outcomes.
